about: OpenRouter models offered in the AI settings and allowed for the instance's AI. Edit freely: `default` is used when nothing is chosen (and when AI_MODEL is not set); `transcription` (a multimodal model) reads photos and scanned PDFs; prices are in US dollars per million tokens (input / output), for information only. List taken from bac-philo-agent (model-catalog.ts), 2026-09.
